# Spell Attack

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Spells and Magic](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#SpellAttack)*

A spell attack is an attack roll made as part of a spell or another magical effect. *See also* "Spells" ("[Casting Spells](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/spells#CastingSpells)").
